name: Commander Thorne

greeting.stranger: You're not supposed to be here. This is Dominion territory.
greeting.acquaintance: You again. I warned you to stay away.

questRelated.nr_caldon_04_dominion_threat: The Concord thinks they can just take what they want. They're wrong. This base, this intelligence—it belongs to the Iron Dominion. We were here first, and we'll be here last. You've interfered with our operations for the last time. Prepare to face the might of the Dominion Remnant.

general: The Iron Dominion will rise again. The Concord is weak, divided.
We follow orders. We maintain order. That's what the galaxy needs.
The Rebel base was a mistake. We're correcting that mistake.
You Concord types think you're heroes. You're just terrorists with better PR.
The Iron Dominion brought peace and order. The Concord brings chaos.

appearance.distinguishingFeatures: Dominion Remnant uniform, military bearing, scar on right cheek, always armed

biography: Commander Thorne is a dedicated Dominion Remnant officer who believes the Iron Dominion was right and the Concord is a mistake. He's been operating in the Outer Rim, trying to recover Dominion intelligence and establish Remnant presence. He's not evil—he genuinely believes in order and stability—but he's willing to do whatever it takes to restore the Iron Dominion. He represents the ongoing threat of the Dominion Remnant and the complexity of the post-war galaxy.
